_comment: Hand-written: iconic item and Minecraft biome (see BIOMES in js/config.js) per region (keyed by the area name in tools/build_countries.py OSM_ADMIN) and per district (keyed by the OpenStreetMap name:en). tools/build_countries.py merges this into data/countries/HKG.json and data/countries/HKG/area-*.json.

Hong Kong Island.lore: Towers of Central and Wan Chai between Victoria Harbour and the Peak, with double-decker trams along the north shore.

Kowloon.lore: Tsim Sha Tsui's waterfront faces the island across Victoria Harbour; behind it, the markets and neon of Mong Kok.

New Territories.lore: Most of Hong Kong's land: country parks, Tai Mo Shan (957 m), walled villages, new towns and the outlying islands.

Central and Western District.note: The Peak Tram has climbed from Central to Victoria Peak since 1888.

Wan Chai District.note: Night races at Happy Valley Racecourse, opened in 1846.

Eastern District.note: Hong Kong's double-decker trams, nicknamed 'ding ding' after their bell, run east to Shau Kei Wan.

Southern District.note: Ocean Park, the marine theme park above Aberdeen and Deep Water Bay.

Yau Tsim Mong District.note: Tung Choi Street's Goldfish Market in Mong Kok, fish sold in hanging bags.

Sham Shui Po District.note: The fabric and button stalls of Ki Lung Street and Yen Chow Street.

Kowloon City District.note: Kowloon Walled City Park, on the site of the demolished walled city.

Wong Tai Sin District.note: Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple, known for fortune-telling with kau cim sticks.

Kwun Tong District.note: Seafood restaurants of Lei Yue Mun village, at the harbour's eastern gap.

Kwai Tsing District.note: Kwai Tsing Container Terminals, one of the busiest ports in the world.

Tsuen Wan District.note: The Tsing Ma Bridge carries road and rail from Ma Wan to Tsing Yi, on the way to the airport.

Tuen Mun District.note: Castle Peak (Tsing Shan) rises above Tuen Mun; Tsing Shan Monastery sits on its slope.

Yuen Long District.note: Yuen Long's bakeries are famous for wife cakes; the Mai Po wetlands are nearby.

North District.note: The Lung Yeuk Tau Heritage Trail in Fanling links walled villages of the Tang clan.

Tai Po District.note: The Lam Tsuen Wishing Trees, where people make wishes at Lunar New Year.

Sha Tin District.note: Ten Thousand Buddhas Monastery, on a hillside above Sha Tin.

Sai Kung District.note: Volcanic rock columns of the Hong Kong UNESCO Global Geopark, at High Island.

Islands District.note: The 34 m bronze Big Buddha at Ngong Ping on Lantau Island.
